description: Hi! We're Low Battery Crew, a first-time team from Malolos, Bulacan led by a Grade 11 STEM student. We're doing "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment." No coding needed - we're telling the story of a forgotten object on the Moon/Mars through writing, research, and visuals. Perfect if you're good at writing, design, or presenting and want to finish a real project this weekend. Beginners welcome!
